  - a key without a ttl surviving a huge clock advance
  - re-setting with a longer ttl and with no ttl
  - delete return values
  - `entries()` returning only live entries with absolute expiry
  - `restore` expiry and the round trip into a second store
  - `createStore()` with no arguments

The tests cover every case in the task, and the temp-file and failed-save cases mock `fs.renameSync`.
